You, of course, should be fed the correct Word in the church you attend, or you should find one that teaches correctly, and give your tithes there. God loves a cheerful giver, and if you give out of faith in God, then you are pleasing to Him (Hebrews 11:6). You must believe in the promises of God, to prosper you when you give, for it to come to pass. Support the Kingdom of God, and reap the many blessing that He has in store for you. Praise God for His Grace!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
